data.name: CapDashStartAll
data.value: Start all — launches Apache, MySQL and Mailpit (the installed ones).

data.name: CapDashStopAll
data.value: Stop all — shuts down every service started by StackR.

data.name: CapDashOpenTerminal
data.value: Opens a terminal where php, composer and mysql are ready to use.

data.name: CapDashOpenWww
data.value: Opens the folder that holds your sites in Explorer.

data.name: CapDashOpenMailpit
data.value: Opens the Mailpit inbox: every mail sent by your sites lands there.

data.name: CapDashGoToVersions
data.value: Opens the Versions page to install this component.

data.value: Creates a site (PHP or Laravel) with its https://name.test address.

data.name: CapRefresh
data.value: Rescans the www folder for added or removed sites.

data.name: CapSitesOpen
data.value: Opens this site in the browser.

data.name: CapSitesFolder
data.value: Opens the site folder in Explorer.

data.name: CapSitesVsCode
data.value: Opens the site folder in Visual Studio Code.

data.value: Creates the site folder and its .test address (and installs the Laravel project).

data.value: Stops the creation in progress and removes the folder.

data.name: CapSitesClose
data.value: Closes this window.

data.value: Shows or hides the MySQL root password.

data.value: Copies the root password to the clipboard.

data.value: Manage your MySQL databases in the browser (http://localhost/adminer).

data.value: Changes the MySQL root password (configuration updated).

data.name: CapDbOpenClient
data.value: Opens a terminal with the mysql client already signed in as root.

data.name: CapDbApply
data.value: Applies the new root password.

data.name: CapDbCancel
data.value: Discards the password change.

data.name: CapDbCopyEnv
data.value: Copies the DB_* lines to paste into your Laravel project's .env.

data.value: Downloads this version (SHA-256 verified) and installs it.

data.name: CapVerCancel
data.value: Stops the download in progress.

data.name: CapVerActivate
data.value: Uses this version: configuration is rewritten and the service restarts.

data.name: CapVerUninstall
data.value: Removes this version from disk (not possible while it is active).

data.value: Clears the view; the log file itself is kept.

data.name: CapLogsCopy
data.value: Copies the displayed text to the clipboard.

data.name: CapLogsOpenFolder
data.value: Opens the logs folder in Explorer.

data.value: Restarts StackR to apply the changed ports and folders.

data.value: Picks another root folder (applied on next launch).

data.name: CapSetResetDefault
data.value: Goes back to the default www folder, inside the StackR root.

data.name: CapSetBrowse
data.value: Picks another folder for your sites.

data.name: CapSetCaTrust
data.value: Trust — adds the StackR local certificate to Windows so the browser shows no warning.

data.name: CapSetPortsSave
data.value: Saves the ports; they apply on next StackR launch.

data.name: CapSetAboutGitHub
data.value: Opens the project page on GitHub.

data.name: CapSetAboutRootFolder
data.value: Opens the StackR root folder in Explorer.

data.name: CapSetAboutLogsFolder
data.value: Opens the logs folder in Explorer.

data.name: CapFrRecheck
data.value: Runs the checks above again.
